about: Office ribbon (Microsoft 365 Current Channel) per app, tab and group, with the HST target tab/group and the UNO commands. Status is computed by scripts/ribbon/check-office-parity.py; inventory_status/inventory_where are the 2026-11-06 snapshot. HST Draw has no Office counterpart: its entry is the owner's PDF-editing ribbon of 2026-11-11 (tabs and the commands each must hold).

sources.IDS: https://github.com/OfficeDev/office-fluent-ui-command-identifiers (Microsoft 365/Current Channel); group order, membership and launchers VERIFIED, English command wording UNVERIFIED
sources.vi_mark: V = seen on a support.microsoft.com/vi-vn page; C = Microsoft's vi-vn pages conflict; U = UNVERIFIED
sources.owner: HST keeps its own tab and group names; no Draw or Record tab; no Clipboard launcher (2026-11-07 10:49)
sources.owner_1217: Developer tab merged into Phần mở rộng in all three apps (owner 2026-11-07 12:17)
sources.dispatch: feasible = the command resolves to a dispatch in the module (queryDispatch on a document frame, beta.5 build, 2026-11-07); context-only commands are checked in their context
